mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Read the result of an ABAP Unit test run.

description: [read-only] Reads the result of the ABAP Unit test run named by run_id*, in one request (GET /sap/bc/adt/abapunit/results/{run_id}), and answers { success, run_id, run_result }: run_result is the result document SAP answered, parsed. Valid once the status is FINISHED; a finished run's result carries executionTime. Optional: with_navigation_uris, format (abapunit or junit). When run_id is given, recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

with_navigation_uris.description: Include ADT navigation URIs in the result payload.

name: HandlerUnitTestResult
